text:
maria: Kicking off staged rollout for runtime v2 today. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over ~2h with pauses for smoke checks. Root ts: 1751234567
oliver: SGTM. Who's on deploy? I can take the 1%->5% step at 11:15 PT.
sam: I can watch metrics + APM for the whole ramp. I'll post thresholds.
maria: @oliver you're on deploy. @sam on metrics. @jen do we have canary cohort list ready? We should exclude EU heavy accounts for first 2 steps.
jen: Yes — excluded cohorts: eu-region, high-slo-customers. Selected cohorts: internal-beta, infra-team, sandbox-prod. Sending list in a sec.
jen: ```
cohort_ids = ["internal-beta","infra-team","sandbox-prod"]
exclude = ["eu-*","enterprise-slo"]
rollout = [{"pct":1,"duration":"15m"},{"pct":5,"duration":"30m"},{"pct":20,"duration":"30m"}]
```
praveen: What's our smoke check runbook? quick health checks I can automate?
sam: Basic checks: 95th latency < 300ms, error-rate < 0.5%, tail 99p tokens per request not increasing > 10%. Also check kv-cache hitrate.
praveen: I'll wire up a dashboard and alert. ETA 10m.
ops-oncall: FYI I have perms to run rollback. signal to rollback = `rollback v2-2026-03-17` or trigger from console. I'll be reachable.
maria: Add small traffic shaping to throttle long requests during first step. Use `max_seq_len=1024` override for canary.
oliver: Deploy started at 11:15 PT -> pushing config.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by oliver: roll id r-20260317-11-15, canary cohort internal-beta, target 1%.
sam: Metrics look fine at +10m. latency flat, error-rate 0.07% :thumbsup: 
jen: Confirmed cohort mapped correctly.
praveen: Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abc123/canary
maria: Hold for 15m then ramp to 5% if no alerts.
oliver: Ramp to 5% at 11:32 PT. pausing.
deploy-bot: Ramp executed: 5%.
sam: After 20m checks: passing. 99p tokens +3% but within expected. No CUs spike.
ops-oncall: Good. No rollbacks.
maria: Plan to 20% in ~30m. if we see sustained errors >0.5% for 5m, rollback.
jen: Will coordinate with sales for excluded customers.
oliver: Quick note: rollback command: `redwoodctl rollout rollback r-20260317-11-15 --to-tag v1`
sam: I'll set an automated alert to ping #incidents if error-rate >0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes.
praveen: All set. dashboard alert done.
maria: Thanks team. I'll post final status when at 100% :rocket: 
oliver: Thanks, glhf.
